reason: The implementation is technically validated and ready for user smoke testing. The six-reference visual analysis is complete, the dashboard contains only truthful current-state information, future destinations are visibly unavailable, capsule states and animation lifecycles are bounded, recording-time preparation cannot replace the recording waveform, and the existing non-activation protections remain present. The authorized automation attempt was blocked when its declared helper disappeared, and correctly no prohibited fallback was used. Static inspection cannot prove actual rendering, two-cycle animation behavior, processing transitions, idle return, or retained focus in a real Windows text target.
